```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  out.width = "100%"
)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tidyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(readxl)
  library(knitr)
  library(patchwork)
  library(sf)
  library(scales)
  library(here)
})

# Keep report inputs and outputs inside the running package copy when the
# package is nested within a different Git checkout.
here::i_am("report.Rmd")

fig_dir   <- here::here("outputs", "figures")
data_dir  <- here::here("outputs", "data")
table_dir <- here::here("outputs", "tables")

`%||%` <- function(x, y) {
  if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
}

source(here::here("R", "comparison_report_ai.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
if (file.exists(here::here("R", "report_map_picker.R"))) {
  source(here::here("R", "report_map_picker.R"), local = knitr::knit_global())
}

include_fig <- function(filename, ...) {
  path <- file.path(fig_dir, filename)
  if (file.exists(path)) {
    knitr::include_graphics(path)
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("*Figure not available: %s*\n", filename))
  }
}

safe_read_csv <- function(filename, dir = table_dir) {
  path <- file.path(dir, filename)
  if (file.exists(path)) read.csv(path) else NULL
}
```

# Executive Summary

```{r load-comparison}
pov_fh  <- tryCatch(read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "pov_fh.xlsx")),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
pov_mfh <- tryCatch(read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "pov_mfh.xlsx")),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
pov_cmp <- tryCatch(read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "pov_comparison_detailed.xlsx")),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
mfh_artifacts <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "mfh_artifacts.rds")),
                          error = function(e) NULL)
run_meta <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "run_metadata.rds")),
                     error = function(e) NULL)
ai_state <- tryCatch(readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "ai_interpretations.rds")),
                     error = function(e) NULL)

sig_summary <- safe_read_csv("significance_summary.csv",
                              file.path(fig_dir, "tables"))
exec_summary <- safe_read_csv("executive_summary.csv",
                               file.path(fig_dir, "tables"))

model_fit_diag <- safe_read_csv("model_fit_diagnostics.csv",
                                file.path(fig_dir, "tables"))
if (is.null(model_fit_diag)) {
  fit_parts <- list(
    safe_read_csv("ufh_model_diagnostics.csv"),
    safe_read_csv("mfh_model_diagnostics.csv")
  )
  fit_parts <- fit_parts[!vapply(fit_parts, is.null, logical(1))]
  model_fit_diag <- if (length(fit_parts) > 0) bind_rows(fit_parts) else NULL
}

selection_parts <- list(
  safe_read_csv("ufh_selection_diagnostics.csv"),
  safe_read_csv("mfh_selection_diagnostics.csv")
)
selection_parts <- selection_parts[!vapply(selection_parts, is.null, logical(1))]
selection_diag <- if (length(selection_parts) > 0) bind_rows(selection_parts) else NULL
mfh_numerical_diag <- safe_read_csv("mfh_numerical_diagnostics.csv")
mfh_variance_selection <- safe_read_csv("mfh_variance_structure_selection.csv")
mfh_mcpe_validation <- safe_read_csv("mfh_mcpe_validation.csv")
mfh_boundary_sensitive <- identical(mfh_artifacts$inference_status, "boundary_sensitive") ||
  identical(run_meta$mfh_inference_status, "boundary_sensitive")
mfh_boundary_warning <- paste(
  "The fitted random-effect covariance is on a boundary (zero variance or correlation at its numerical limit).",
  "Estimates remain available, but normal/delta intervals and p-values can substantially understate uncertainty about change.",
  "Treat significance as provisional; compare Direct results and alternative admissible models before external conclusions.",
  "Increasing bootstrap draws alone does not resolve this limitation.")

# MFH model requested in the setup. The MFH3/MFH2 variance-structure rule runs
# only when MFH3 (or the legacy AUTO) was requested; when MFH1 or MFH2 was
# chosen directly, the report does not discuss MFH3.
mfh_requested_model <- toupper(as.character(
  (mfh_artifacts$diag_model_requested %||% run_meta$mfh_requested_model %||%
     mfh_variance_selection$requested_model %||% NA_character_)[1L]
))
mfh_selected_model <- toupper(as.character(
  (mfh_artifacts$diag_model %||% run_meta$mfh_selected_model %||%
     mfh_variance_selection$selected_model %||% NA_character_)[1L]
))
mfh_rule_applied <- isTRUE(mfh_requested_model %in% c("AUTO", "MFH3")) ||
  isTRUE(as.logical((mfh_variance_selection$test_available %||% NA)[1L]))

# Indicator labels written by the Comparison step (poverty if absent).
indicator_info <- safe_read_csv("indicator_info.csv")
is_mean_welfare <- identical(as.character(indicator_info$indicator_type[1] %||% "poverty"),
                             "mean_welfare")
change_noun <- as.character(indicator_info$change_noun[1] %||% "poverty rate")
if (is.na(change_noun) || !nzchar(change_noun)) change_noun <- "poverty rate"
indicator_title <- if (is_mean_welfare) "Mean Welfare" else "Poverty"
level_noun_plural <- if (is_mean_welfare) "mean welfare values" else "poverty rates"
# Mean welfare: changes are percentage changes of the mean; prices as entered.
change_is_percent <- is_mean_welfare &&
  identical(as.character(indicator_info$change_unit[1] %||% ""), "%")
change_unit_suffix <- if (change_is_percent) " (%)" else if (!is_mean_welfare) " (percentage points)" else ""
inference_label <- function(x) {
  labels <- c(boundary_sensitive = "Provisional", period_independence = "Independent years",
              regular = "Approximate", ok = "Approximate", not_recorded = "Not recorded",
              unavailable = "Unavailable")
  result <- unname(labels[as.character(x)])
  ifelse(is.na(result), gsub("_", " ", as.character(x)), result)
}
price_basis <- as.character(indicator_info$price_basis[1] %||% "")
if (is.na(price_basis)) price_basis <- ""
price_sentence <- if (is_mean_welfare && nzchar(price_basis)) {
  paste0("Mean welfare is in ", price_basis, ".")
} else {
  ""
}
# Units of the change/RMSE box plots (sae_change_rmse_by_method()).
change_box_units <- if (is_mean_welfare) {
  paste("For mean welfare, the change is in ln mean welfare: ln(mean in the later",
        "year) minus ln(mean in the earlier year), close to the proportional change",
        "(times 100, roughly the percentage change); its RMSE is on the same log scale.")
} else {
  sprintf("Changes in the %s and their RMSEs are in percentage points.", change_noun)
}
```

```{r sig-summary-table}
if (!is.null(sig_summary)) {
  sig_summary_display <- sig_summary
  if ("inference_status" %in% names(sig_summary_display)) sig_summary_display$inference_status <- inference_label(sig_summary_display$inference_status)
  # A count is NA when no domain could be tested (inference unavailable): say so instead of showing 0 or NA.
  for (count_col in intersect(c("pointwise_significant", "bh_significant", "bonferroni_significant"), names(sig_summary_display))) {
    count_val <- sig_summary_display[[count_col]]
    sig_summary_display[[count_col]] <- ifelse(is.na(count_val), "Unavailable", format(count_val, trim = TRUE))
  }
  summary_labels <- c(method = "Method", pointwise_significant = "Pointwise", bh_significant = "BH",
                      bonferroni_significant = "Bonferroni", tested_domains = "Tested", total_domains = "Domains",
                      inference_status = "Inference")
  names(sig_summary_display) <- ifelse(names(sig_summary_display) %in% names(summary_labels),
                                       summary_labels[names(sig_summary_display)], names(sig_summary_display))
  kable(sig_summary_display, digits = 0,
        caption = if (mfh_boundary_sensitive)
          "Exploratory counts of pointwise-significant domains; adjusted counts separate (MFH inference is provisional)" else
          "Exploratory counts of pointwise-significant domains; BH and Bonferroni counts separate")
}
```

# Run Setup

```{r run-setup}
if (!is.null(run_meta)) {
  bm <- run_meta$benchmarking %||% list()
  benchmark_files <- run_meta$input_manifest$file_name[
    run_meta$input_manifest$input_role == "benchmark"] %||% character()
  benchmark_files <- benchmark_files[!is.na(benchmark_files) & nzchar(benchmark_files)]
  benchmark_source <- bm$source %||% ""
  if (is.na(benchmark_source) || !nzchar(benchmark_source)) {
    benchmark_source <- if (!isTRUE(bm$enabled)) "Not applicable" else if (length(benchmark_files)) {
      "Fixed external target"
    } else if (!is.null(run_meta$input_manifest)) "Survey-derived (no external target recorded)" else "Not recorded"
  }
  benchmark_target <- bm$target_path %||% ""
  if (is.na(benchmark_target) || !nzchar(benchmark_target)) {
    benchmark_target <- if (length(benchmark_files)) paste(benchmark_files, collapse = "; ") else
      if (grepl("survey", benchmark_source, ignore.case = TRUE) || !isTRUE(bm$enabled)) "Not applicable" else "Not recorded"
  }
  ai_meta <- run_meta$ai_interpretations %||% list()
  generated_sections <- ai_meta$generated_sections %||% character()
  generated_sections_label <- if (length(generated_sections)) {
    paste(generated_sections, collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "none"
  }
  numeric_qa <- ai_meta$numeric_qa_status %||% character()
  numeric_qa_label <- if (length(numeric_qa)) {
    paste(sprintf("%s=%s", names(numeric_qa), numeric_qa), collapse = ", ")
  } else {
    "not performed"
  }
  mfh_variance_rule <- run_meta$mfh_variance_structure_selection %||% list()
  mfh_refvar_label <- if (isTRUE(mfh_variance_rule$test_available)) {
    paste0(mfh_variance_rule$adjustment %||% "not recorded", " (applied)")
  } else {
    paste0(
      "not applied",
      if (nzchar(mfh_variance_rule$reason %||% "")) {
        paste0(" - ", mfh_variance_rule$reason)
      } else {
        ""
      }
    )
  }
  setup_tbl <- data.frame(
    Item = c(
      "Application version",
      "Country or territory",
      "Run ID",
      "Run label",
      "Run folder",
      "Archived outputs",
      "Benchmarking",
      "Benchmark level",
      "Benchmark source",
      "Benchmark target file",
      "Cross-year PSU design (MFH)",
      "Effective MFH sampling covariance option",
      "Requested MFH model",
      "Selected MFH model",
      "MFH3 reference-variance test adjustment",
      "Analysis seed",
      "Bootstrap replicates (MFH / UFH / benchmark)",
      "UFH change variance assumption",
      "Change inference",
      "External AI enabled",
      "AI interpretations included",
      "AI provider and model",
      "AI sections generated",
      "AI numeric QA (warning-only)",
      "AI human-review status"
    ),
    Value = c(
      run_meta$wizard_version %||% run_meta$application_version %||% "",
      run_meta$country_or_territory %||% "Not specified",
      run_meta$run_id %||% "",
      run_meta$run_label %||% "",
      run_meta$run_folder %||% "",
      run_meta$archived_outputs %||% "",
      if (isTRUE(bm$enabled)) "enabled" else "off",
      bm$level_label %||% bm$level %||% "",
      benchmark_source,
      benchmark_target,
      paste(c(run_meta$psu_design_label %||% "Not recorded", run_meta$psu_design_warning),
            collapse = " "),
      run_meta$mfh_cov_choice %||% "Not recorded",
      run_meta$mfh_requested_model %||% "",
      run_meta$mfh_selected_model %||% "",
      mfh_refvar_label,
      run_meta$analysis_seed %||% "",
      paste(run_meta$mcpe_bootstrap_replicates %||% "not recorded",
            run_meta$ufh_bootstrap_replicates %||% "not recorded",
            run_meta$benchmark_bootstrap_replicates %||% "not recorded", sep = " / "),
      run_meta$ufh_change_variance_assumption %||% "",
      "pointwise primary; BH and Bonferroni sensitivities reported",
      if (isTRUE(run_meta$ai$enabled)) "yes (advisory commentary only)" else "no",
      if (isTRUE(params$include_ai)) "yes, where successfully generated" else "no",
      paste(
        ai_meta$provider %||% run_meta$ai$provider %||% "not recorded",
        ai_meta$model %||% "model not recorded",
        sep = " / "
      ),
      generated_sections_label,
      numeric_qa_label,
      ai_meta$human_review_status %||% "not reviewed"
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  if (is_mean_welfare && nzchar(price_basis)) {
    setup_tbl <- rbind(setup_tbl, data.frame(Item = "Prices (mean welfare)",
                                             Value = price_basis, check.names = FALSE))
  }
  if (!mfh_rule_applied) {
    # MFH1 or MFH2 was chosen directly: the MFH3 test was not run.
    setup_tbl <- setup_tbl[setup_tbl$Item != "MFH3 reference-variance test adjustment", , drop = FALSE]
  }
  kable(setup_tbl, caption = "Run configuration and output locations", row.names = FALSE)
}
```

# Comparison of UFH and MFH

This section compares the univariate (UFH) and multivariate (MFH) Fay-Herriot pipelines side by side, examining regression formulas, normality diagnostics, precision metrics, poverty maps, RMSE maps, and change analyses.

```{r ai-overview, results='asis'}
cat(comparison_ai_assurance_html(ai_state, include_ai = isTRUE(params$include_ai)))
cat(comparison_ai_section_html(ai_state, "overview",
                               include_ai = isTRUE(params$include_ai)))
```

```{r mfh-availability, results='asis'}
mfh_status <- if (!is.null(mfh_artifacts)) {
  list(
    fit_failed  = isTRUE(mfh_artifacts$model_fit_failed),
    refvar_zero = isTRUE(mfh_artifacts$refvar_zero),
    var_choice  = mfh_artifacts$var_choice %||% "(unset)",
    cov_choice  = mfh_artifacts$cov_choice %||% "(unset)",
    requested_model = mfh_artifacts$diag_model_requested %||% "(unset)",
    diag_model  = mfh_artifacts$diag_model %||% "(unset)",
    selection_reason = (mfh_artifacts$variance_structure_selection %||% list())$reason %||% "not recorded",
    bad_rows    = mfh_artifacts$bad_vardir_rows %||% 0L,
    n_domains   = mfh_artifacts$n_domains %||% NA_integer_,
    n_fitted    = mfh_artifacts$n_domains_fitted %||% mfh_artifacts$n_domains %||% NA_integer_
  )
} else {
  NULL
}

mfh_not_executed <- !is.null(mfh_status) &&
  mfh_status$fit_failed

if (mfh_boundary_sensitive && !mfh_not_executed) {
  cat("\n> **MFH change significance is provisional.** ", mfh_boundary_warning, "\n\n", sep = "")
}

mfh_change <- safe_read_csv("comparison_final.csv")
mfh_change_available <- !is.null(mfh_change) &&
  "diff" %in% names(mfh_change) &&
  any(is.finite(suppressWarnings(as.numeric(mfh_change$diff))))

if (!is.null(mfh_status) && mfh_status$bad_rows > 0 && !mfh_not_executed) {
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<div class=\"alert alert-info\">",
      "<strong>Note:</strong> %s of %s domains had missing/non-finite sampling variances ",
      "and were excluded from MFH fitting. Their MFH estimates are reported as NA. ",
      "The MFH model was fitted on the remaining %s domains.",
      "</div>\n"
    ),
    mfh_status$bad_rows,
    mfh_status$n_domains,
    mfh_status$n_fitted
  ))
}

if (!is.null(mfh_status) && !mfh_not_executed && !mfh_rule_applied) {
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<div class=\"alert alert-info\">",
      "<strong>Selected MFH model:</strong> %s, as chosen in the setup. ",
      "The MFH comparison tables and plots use this model's estimates from ",
      "<code>pov_mfh.xlsx</code>. Other MFH variants are fitted only for diagnostics ",
      "and are not part of the MFH estimate export.",
      "</div>\n"
    ),
    mfh_status$diag_model
  ))
} else if (!is.null(mfh_status) && !mfh_not_executed) {
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<div class=\"alert alert-info\">",
      "<strong>Selected MFH variant:</strong> %s (requested rule: %s). ",
      "Selection reason: %s ",
      "The displayed MFH comparison tables and plots use the selected model export ",
      "from <code>pov_mfh.xlsx</code>. Other MFH variants may be fitted internally ",
      "for diagnostics/model selection, but they are not exposed in the user-facing ",
      "MFH estimate export.",
      "</div>\n"
    ),
    mfh_status$diag_model,
    mfh_status$requested_model,
    mfh_status$selection_reason
  ))
}

if (mfh_not_executed) {
  reason <- "The selected MFH model did not return a valid fit object."

  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<div class=\"alert alert-warning\">",
      "<strong>MFH was not executed for this configuration.</strong><br>",
      "%s<br>",
      "Selected options: <code>var_choice = %s</code>, <code>cov_choice = %s</code>, ",
      "<code>diagnostic model = %s</code>.<br>",
      "MFH maps, UFH-vs-MFH comparisons, and MFH change analyses are omitted or NA-filled.",
      "</div>\n"
    ),
    reason,
    mfh_status$var_choice,
    mfh_status$cov_choice,
    mfh_status$diag_model
  ))
} else if (!is.null(mfh_status) && !mfh_change_available) {
  cat(
    paste0(
      "<div class=\"alert alert-info\">",
      "<strong>MFH fitted, but MFH change analysis is not available.</strong><br>",
      "The level estimates are available, but the MCPE-based change analysis did not produce finite differences. ",
      "This can happen with raw direct variances in the parametric bootstrap.",
      "</div>\n"
    )
  )
}
```

```{r mfh-variance-structure, results='asis'}
if (!mfh_rule_applied) {
  # MFH1 or MFH2 was chosen in the setup: describe that model only.
  cat("## MFH Variance Structure\n\n")
  .mfh_model_note <- switch(
    mfh_selected_model %||% "",
    MFH1 = paste(
      "MFH1 allows a different random-effect variance in each year and treats",
      "the area random effects of different years as independent."
    ),
    MFH2 = paste(
      "MFH2 assumes that the area random effects have the same variance in both",
      "years and are correlated over time, with correlation rho between",
      "consecutive years."
    ),
    ""
  )
  if (!is.null(mfh_status) && !mfh_not_executed && nzchar(.mfh_model_note)) {
    cat(sprintf(
      paste(
        "The MFH model was chosen in the setup: **%s**. No data-driven",
        "variance-structure test was run. %s Its estimated variance parameters",
        "are listed in the MFH Convergence Check below.\n\n"
      ),
      mfh_selected_model, .mfh_model_note
    ))
  } else if (!is.na(mfh_selected_model) && nzchar(mfh_selected_model)) {
    cat(sprintf("The MFH model was chosen in the setup: **%s**.\n\n", mfh_selected_model))
  } else {
    cat("MFH results are not available for this run.\n\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("## MFH Variance-Structure Selection\n\n")
  .rule_lead <- if (identical(mfh_requested_model, "AUTO")) {
    "The automatic MFH rule (legacy AUTO setting) was requested, so MFH3 and MFH2 were compared."
  } else {
    "MFH3 was requested, so the MFH3/MFH2 variance-structure rule was applied."
  }
  .test_ran <- !is.null(mfh_variance_selection) &&
    isTRUE(as.logical(mfh_variance_selection$test_available[1L]))
  cat(paste(
    .rule_lead,
    "MFH3, which allows a different random-effect variance in each year, is fitted first.",
    "If it does not converge or cannot be fitted, the reason is recorded and MFH2 is used.",
    "If MFH3 converges, its reference-variance test compares the year-specific",
    "random-effect variances: MFH3 is kept when at least one adjusted test rejects",
    "equal variances at the configured level; otherwise MFH2 is used."
  ))
  if (.test_ran) {
    cat(paste(
      "",
      "Bonferroni is the confirmatory default, while Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) is",
      "available as a less-conservative sensitivity option. These adjustments apply",
      "across pairwise **time-variance contrasts**, not across geographic areas.",
      "With two analysis years there is only one contrast, so raw, Bonferroni, and",
      "BH p-values are identical."
    ))
  }
  cat("\n\n")
  .rule_reason <- if (!is.null(mfh_status)) mfh_status$selection_reason else
    mfh_variance_selection$reason[1L] %||% ""
  if (!is.na(.rule_reason) && nzchar(.rule_reason) && !identical(.rule_reason, "not recorded")) {
    cat("**Result:** ", .rule_reason, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (!is.null(mfh_variance_selection)) {
    .sel_show <- mfh_variance_selection[, setdiff(names(mfh_variance_selection), "reason"),
                                        drop = FALSE]
    .sel_show <- .sel_show[, vapply(.sel_show, function(x) !all(is.na(x)), logical(1)),
                           drop = FALSE]
    print(kable(.sel_show, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE,
                caption = "MFH3 convergence and reference-variance model-selection decision"))
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```

## MCPE Bootstrap Assurance

The table below reports run-specific computational diagnostics for the parametric-bootstrap MCPE calculation, including successful refits, failures, accepted refits on covariance boundaries, covariance repairs, and Monte Carlo standard errors. The boundary fraction uses accepted refits as its denominator. Zero-variance and correlation-limit counts can overlap. These diagnostics assess numerical execution and simulation precision; they do not, by themselves, constitute an independent validation of statistical bias or interval coverage. A high boundary fraction deserves sensitivity review even when the original fit is interior. No boundary-fraction cutoff has been validated as an inferential guarantee.

```{r mfh-mcpe-validation-table}
if (!is.null(mfh_mcpe_validation)) {
  kable(mfh_mcpe_validation, digits = 5,
        caption = "MCPE bootstrap execution and Monte Carlo precision diagnostics")
}
```

## Model Fit Diagnostics

The R2 and adjusted R2 values below are OLS companion diagnostics for the selected formulas. They are useful for model screening and communication, but they are not a definitive mixed-model fit measure.

```{r model-fit-diagnostics}
if (!is.null(model_fit_diag) && nrow(model_fit_diag) > 0) {
  fit_display <- model_fit_diag %>%
    transmute(
      Method = method,
      Year = year,
      Formula = formula,
      `Domains used` = n_domains,
      `Predictors` = n_predictors,
      AIC = round(as.numeric(AIC), 4),
      BIC = round(as.numeric(BIC), 4),
      logLik = round(as.numeric(logLik), 4),
      Sigma = round(as.numeric(residual_sd), 4),
      `Random-effect variance` = round(as.numeric(random_effect_variance), 6),
      `OLS companion R2` = round(as.numeric(ols_companion_r2), 4),
      `OLS companion adjusted R2` = round(as.numeric(ols_companion_adj_r2), 4)
    )
  kable(fit_display,
        caption = "Model fit diagnostics for selected UFH and MFH formulas")
} else {
  cat("*Model fit diagnostics were not exported for this run.*\n")
}
```

## MFH Numerical Diagnostics

```{r mfh-numerical-label, include=FALSE}
# The diagnostics describe the selected MFH model; name it (and say whether a
# robust refit was used) instead of assuming the robust MFH2 fit.
mfh_numerical_fit_label <- local({
  d <- mfh_numerical_diag
  has <- !is.null(d) && nrow(d) > 0
  m <- if (has && "model" %in% names(d)) toupper(as.character(d$model[1])) else NA_character_
  if (length(m) != 1L || is.na(m) || !nzchar(m)) m <- mfh_selected_model
  if (length(m) != 1L || is.na(m) || !nzchar(m)) m <- "MFH"
  robust <- has && "robust_refit_used" %in% names(d) && isTRUE(as.logical(d$robust_refit_used[1]))
  paste0(if (robust) "robust " else "", m)
})
```

The table below records the inversion method and condition-number diagnostic
for the selected `r mfh_numerical_fit_label` fit. Successful Cholesky paths report a low-cost estimate
derived from the Cholesky factor; fallback paths report an exact value when it
can be computed. A generalized inverse or an unavailable Fisher-information
inverse requires review. The `g3_available` flag refers to the package's analytical
MSE approximation. The selected model instead uses joint bootstrap MSE when its
fit passes the numerical checks and enough usable refits are available. It does
not substitute a partial analytical MSE when that approximation is unavailable.

```{r mfh-numerical-diagnostics, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(mfh_numerical_diag) && nrow(mfh_numerical_diag) > 0) {
  print(kable(mfh_numerical_diag,
              digits = 4,
              caption = "MFH numerical diagnostics and g3/MSE availability"))
  needs_attention <- any(
    mfh_numerical_diag$diagnostic_status %in%
      c("generalized_inverse_used", "unavailable", "robust_refit_failed",
        "robust_refit_no_extended_diagnostics", "model_fit_failed",
        "model_fit_skipped") |
      mfh_numerical_diag$mse_status == "unavailable_fisher_information",
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  if (needs_attention) {
    cat("\n> **Review required:** MFH numerical diagnostics indicate a generalized inverse, an unavailable inverse, a failed/skipped fit, or unavailable g3/MSE.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("*MFH numerical diagnostics were not exported for this run.*\n")
}
```

## MFH Convergence Check

The selected MFH fit must pass an independent REML endpoint check of its score,
local curvature and boundary conditions. MFH2 uses a constrained REML refit when
needed. Status `ok` means that the numerical checks passed; it is not a proof of
a global maximum. Failed fits cannot produce significance results. A valid
zero-variance boundary is allowed for estimation, but its change significance is
provisional. Correlation at the numerical stationary limit also receives
`boundary_sensitive` inference status. Passing numerical checks does not establish
nominal confidence-interval coverage. Annual MSE and cross-year prediction-error
moments for the selected model are estimated together by bootstrap, with the
same endpoint checks applied to every refit.

```{r mfh-convergence-check, results='asis'}
mfh_conv <- safe_read_csv("mfh_convergence_check.csv")
if (!is.null(mfh_conv) && nrow(mfh_conv) > 0) {
  conv_show <- mfh_conv[, intersect(c("model", "selected", "msae_converged", "iterations",
                                      "sigma2", "sigma2_1", "sigma2_2", "rho",
                                      "newton_decrement", "loglik_gain_approx", "status",
                                      "covariance_boundary", "inference_status"),
                                    names(mfh_conv)), drop = FALSE]
  conv_show <- conv_show[, vapply(conv_show, function(x) !all(is.na(x)), logical(1)), drop = FALSE]
  conv_labels <- c(model = "Model", selected = "Selected", msae_converged = "msae conv.",
                   iterations = "Iter.", sigma2 = "sigma2", sigma2_1 = "sigma2 y1",
                   sigma2_2 = "sigma2 y2", rho = "rho", newton_decrement = "Newton decr.",
                   loglik_gain_approx = "logLik gain", status = "Status",
                   covariance_boundary = "Covariance boundary", inference_status = "Inference status")
  names(conv_show) <- unname(conv_labels[names(conv_show)])
  conv_show[["Newton decr."]] <- signif(conv_show[["Newton decr."]], 3)
  conv_show[["logLik gain"]] <- signif(conv_show[["logLik gain"]], 3)
  print(kable(conv_show, digits = 5, row.names = FALSE,
              caption = "REML check at msae's end point (one row per fitted MFH model)"))
  cat("\n")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(mfh_conv))) {
    cat(sprintf("- **%s%s:** %s\n", mfh_conv$model[i],
                if (isTRUE(as.logical(mfh_conv$selected[i]))) " (selected)" else "",
                mfh_conv$message[i]))
  }
  sel <- mfh_conv[as.logical(mfh_conv$selected) %in% TRUE, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(sel) > 0 && !identical(sel$status[1], "ok")) {
    cat(sprintf(paste0(
      "\n> **Review required:** the selected model (%s) is not at a REML maximum ",
      "(status `%s`). Its estimates, MSEs and change tests rest on these variance ",
      "parameters. Compare with the other MFH models and the UFH results before ",
      "reporting.\n"), sel$model[1], sel$status[1]))
  }
} else {
  cat("*The MFH convergence check was not exported for this run.*\n")
}
```

## Covariate Selection Diagnostics

This table records whether LASSO screening was used before stepwise selection. When LASSO is off, the stepwise procedure receives the original candidate set.

```{r selection-diagnostics}
if (!is.null(selection_diag) && nrow(selection_diag) > 0) {
  selection_display <- selection_diag %>%
    mutate(
      lasso_enabled = as.character(lasso_enabled),
      lambda_choice = as.character(lambda_choice),
      fallback_used = as.character(fallback_used)
    ) %>%
    transmute(
      Model = model,
      Outcome = outcome,
      `LASSO screening` = ifelse(tolower(lasso_enabled) %in% c("true", "yes", "1"),
                                 "on", "off"),
      `Lambda choice` = lambda_choice,
      `Candidate variables` = n_candidates,
      `Numeric candidates` = n_numeric_candidates,
      `Complete cases for LASSO` = n_complete_cases,
      `LASSO-selected variables` = n_selected,
      `Fallback used` = fallback_used,
      Note = note
    )
  kable(selection_display,
        caption = "Covariate screening diagnostics before stepwise model selection")
} else {
  cat("*Covariate selection diagnostics were not exported for this run.*\n")
}
```

## Normality Diagnostics

MFH residuals are standardized using their fitted covariance, including fixed-effect estimation. They remain correlated, so the Shapiro-Wilk p-values are descriptive checks rather than exact independent-sample normality tests.

```{r normality-tests}
}
```

## `r indicator_title` Maps

Maps of the estimated `r level_noun_plural` by domain and year, arranged as a table:
one row per estimation method and one column per year, so that differences
between methods can be read down a column and changes over time along a row.
The rows are Direct, UFH and the selected MFH model; when benchmarking is on,
each model's row is followed by its benchmarked estimates. In the HTML report,
the **Methods** list above the maps selects which methods are shown, for
example UFH and UFH benchmarked only. All poverty maps
share one colour scale and one value range (across all methods and years), so
the same colour means the same value in every panel: lighter areas
indicate lower values and darker areas higher values. Domains without an
estimate are shown in grey. The single maps are also saved separately in

## Statistical Significance of `r indicator_title` Changes

```{r boundary-significance-warning, results='asis'}
if (mfh_boundary_sensitive) {
  cat("\n> **Provisional MFH significance:** ", mfh_boundary_warning,
      " The tables retain raw p-values and interval endpoints for audit and sensitivity analysis.\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

The primary significance status is pointwise at alpha = 0.05: a domain is
classified as significant when its unadjusted two-sided p-value is below 0.05,
equivalently when the plotted nominal pointwise 95% confidence interval excludes zero.
The table also reports Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) and Bonferroni adjustments across
the geographic domains within each method. With valid p-values, BH targets the
false discovery rate under its dependence assumptions; Bonferroni controls the
family-wise probability of any false rejection. Neither adjustment repairs
undercoverage or invalid boundary-sensitive p-values. The significance
figures below draw a change in red when its 95% confidence interval excludes
zero; the table gives the pointwise, BH and Bonferroni results for every domain,
and the summary at the top of the report counts the significant domains under
each rule. Pointwise counts summarize exploratory findings across domains;
familywide conclusions must use a prespecified family and error-control rule.
`r if (mfh_rule_applied) "They are separate from the MFH3 reference-variance test adjustment, which applies only to pairwise time-variance contrasts when MFH3 is fitted." else ""`

`r if (change_is_percent) paste("For mean welfare, each change is the percentage change of the estimated mean: 100 x (mean in the later year / mean in the earlier year - 1). Its 95% interval and p-value are computed on the log of that ratio, from the MSEs of the two estimates and their covariance (from the MCPE for MFH; UFH treats the two years as independent), so the interval is not symmetric around the estimate. The change in currency units is kept in the Excel tables (columns ending in _eur).", price_sentence) else ""`

```{r sig-comparison, results='asis'}
sig_cmp <- tryCatch(
  read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "statistical_significance_comparison.xlsx")),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (!is.null(sig_cmp)) {
  sig_cols <- c(
    "domain", "method", "diff", "mse", "lb", "ub",
    "p_value", "significant_unadjusted",
    "p_value_bh", "significant_bh",
    "p_value_bonferroni", "significant_bonferroni", "inference_status"
  )
  sig_display <- sig_cmp %>%
    select(any_of(sig_cols)) %>%
    mutate(
      .method_order = match(
        as.character(method),
        c("FH", "FH Benchmarked", "MFH", "MFH Benchmarked")
      ),
      .domain_order = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(as.character(domain)))
    ) %>%
    arrange(.method_order, is.na(.domain_order), .domain_order, domain) %>%
    select(-.method_order, -.domain_order)
  sig_labels <- c(
    domain = "Domain", method = "Method",
    diff = if (!is_mean_welfare) "Change (pp)" else paste0("Change", change_unit_suffix),
    mse = if (change_is_percent) "MSE of % change" else if (!is_mean_welfare) "MSE (pp^2)" else "MSE",
    lb = "95% CI lower", ub = "95% CI upper",
    p_value = "Pointwise p-value",
    significant_unadjusted = "Pointwise significant",
    p_value_bh = "BH-adjusted p-value",
    significant_bh = "BH significant",
    p_value_bonferroni = "Bonferroni-adjusted p-value",
    significant_bonferroni = "Bonferroni significant",
    inference_status = "Inference"
  )
  if (!is_mean_welfare) {
    for (column in intersect(c("diff", "lb", "ub"), names(sig_display))) sig_display[[column]] <- 100 * sig_display[[column]]
    if ("mse" %in% names(sig_display)) sig_display$mse <- 10000 * sig_display$mse
  }
  if ("inference_status" %in% names(sig_display)) sig_display$inference_status <- inference_label(sig_display$inference_status)
  names(sig_display) <- unname(sig_labels[names(sig_display)])
  cat('<div class="full-significance-table">')
  cat(as.character(kable(
    sig_display,
    format = "html",
    digits = 4,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"',
    caption = sprintf(
      "Complete statistical significance comparison (%d rows; pointwise status is primary%s)",
      nrow(sig_display), if (mfh_boundary_sensitive) "; MFH significance is provisional" else ""
    )
  )))
  cat('</div>')
} else {
  cat("*The statistical-significance workbook was not available for this run.*\n")
}
```

### Estimated changes and their RMSEs by method

The box plots below compare, across domains, the **estimated change** between
the two years (the later year minus the earlier year) and the **RMSE of that
change** for each method: Direct, UFH, the selected MFH model and, when
benchmarking is on, UFH benchmarked and MFH benchmarked. `r change_box_units`
Each point is one domain; boxes show the median and interquartile range, and
whiskers reach the most extreme value within 1.5 times the interquartile range.
The boxes show how the changes and their precision vary across domains, not the
uncertainty around one domain's estimate; a lower RMSE means a more precise
estimate of the change. The RMSE of a direct change treats the two survey years
as independent, as UFH does; MFH uses the covariance between the years. In the
HTML report, the **Methods** list selects the methods shown and the axes fit
the selected methods; the Word report shows all methods.

```{r change-rmse-boxplots, results='asis'}
change_rmse_csv <- file.path(table_dir, "change_rmse_by_method.csv")
change_rmse_png <- file.path(fig_dir, "change_comparisons", "change_rmse_boxplots.png")
if (file.exists(change_rmse_csv) || file.exists(change_rmse_png)) {
  cat(sae_box_picker_markdown(change_rmse_csv, change_rmse_png,
                              id = "sae-box-picker-changes",
                              label = "Estimated changes and their RMSEs by method"))
} else {
  cat("*Changes and RMSEs by method were not available for this run.*\n\n")
}
change_rmse_summary <- tryCatch(
  read_excel(file.path(data_dir, "change_estimate_comparison.xlsx"),
             sheet = "Change and RMSE summary"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (!is.null(change_rmse_summary) && nrow(change_rmse_summary)) {
  display <- data.frame(
    Method = change_rmse_summary$method,
    Domains = change_rmse_summary$domains,
    `Median change` = change_rmse_summary$change_median,
    `Change, 25th percentile` = change_rmse_summary$change_percentile_25,
    `Change, 75th percentile` = change_rmse_summary$change_percentile_75,
    `Median RMSE` = change_rmse_summary$rmse_median,
    `Mean RMSE` = change_rmse_summary$rmse_mean,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
  print(kable(display, digits = if (is_mean_welfare) 4 else 2,
              caption = sprintf("Estimated changes and their RMSEs across domains (%s; unweighted domain summaries)",
                                change_rmse_summary$unit[1])))
}
```

### Paired comparison of UFH and MFH changes

The figure below compares the **estimated changes themselves** domain by
domain, using the later year minus the earlier year. Poverty-rate changes are
in **percentage points**; mean-welfare changes are **percentage changes** of
the mean. Negative values indicate a decrease. Below the equality line, the MFH
estimate is lower than the UFH estimate; that does not establish greater
accuracy or statistical significance. This comparison uses unbenchmarked
estimates, as do the CI-width comparisons below.

```{r change-estimate-summary, results='asis'}
change_path <- file.path(data_dir, "change_estimate_comparison.xlsx")
change_summary <- tryCatch(read_excel(change_path, sheet = "Distribution summary"), error = function(e) NULL)
change_paired <- tryCatch(read_excel(change_path, sheet = "Paired summary"), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(change_summary) && nrow(change_summary)) {
  display <- change_summary[, c("method", "domains", "minimum", "median", "mean", "maximum", "unit")]
  names(display) <- c("Method", "Domains", "Minimum", "Median", "Mean", "Maximum", "Unit")
  print(kable(display, digits = 2, caption = "Estimated changes across matched domains (unweighted domain summaries)"))
}
if (!is.null(change_paired) && nrow(change_paired)) {
  p <- change_paired[1, ]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n**%s %s %s:** %d finite matched domains. MFH changes are lower in %d, higher in %d, and equal in %d domains. The median paired difference (MFH minus UFH) is %.2f %s. These are descriptive comparisons, not tests of the difference between estimators.\n\n",
    p$year_to, if (change_is_percent) "relative to" else "minus", p$year_from,
    p$finite_paired_domains, p$MFH_lower_domains,
    p$MFH_higher_domains, p$equal_domains, p$median_MFH_minus_UFH_change, p$unit))
  if (p$excluded_nonfinite_pairs + p$UFH_only_domains + p$MFH_only_domains > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("Excluded: %d matched pairs with nonfinite changes; %d UFH-only and %d MFH-only domains.\n\n",
      p$excluded_nonfinite_pairs, p$UFH_only_domains, p$MFH_only_domains))
  }
}
```

### Distribution of 95% confidence-interval widths

The table and figure below compare the full width of each pointwise 95%
confidence interval (`upper bound - lower bound`) across matched domains; the
figure preserves the domain-level pairing. Points below the dashed equality
line have narrower MFH intervals. A narrower
interval does not by itself imply a significant change, because significance
also depends on how far the estimated change lies from zero.

```{r ci-width-summary, results='asis'}
ci_width_path <- file.path(data_dir, "ci_width_comparison.xlsx")
ci_width_domain <- tryCatch(
  read_excel(ci_width_path, sheet = "Domain comparison"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
ci_width_summary <- tryCatch(
  read_excel(ci_width_path, sheet = "Distribution summary"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
ci_width_paired <- tryCatch(
  read_excel(ci_width_path, sheet = "Paired summary"),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

if (!is.null(ci_width_summary) && nrow(ci_width_summary) > 0) {
  ci_summary_display <- ci_width_summary
  names(ci_summary_display) <- c(
    method = "Method", domains = "Domains", minimum = "Minimum",
    percentile_25 = "25th percentile", median = "Median", mean = "Mean",
    percentile_75 = "75th percentile", maximum = "Maximum", unit = "Unit"
  )[names(ci_summary_display)]
  cat(as.character(kable(
    ci_summary_display,
    format = "html",
    digits = 2,
    escape = TRUE,
    table.attr = 'class="table table-condensed"',
    caption = "Distribution of pointwise 95% confidence-interval widths"
  )))
}

if (!is.null(ci_width_paired) && nrow(ci_width_paired) > 0) {
  .paired <- ci_width_paired[1, ]
  cat(sprintf(
    paste0(
      "<p><strong>Paired-domain result.</strong> MFH intervals are narrower in ",
      "%d of %d matched domains and wider in %d. The median MFH interval is ",
      "%.1f%% narrower than the corresponding UFH interval; the median paired ",
      "width difference (MFH minus UFH) is %.2f %s.</p>"
    ),
    as.integer(.paired$MFH_narrower_domains),
    as.integer(.paired$matched_domains),
    as.integer(.paired$MFH_wider_domains),
    as.numeric(.paired$median_MFH_percent_width_reduction),
    as.numeric(.paired$median_MFH_minus_UFH_width),
    as.character(.paired$unit)
  ))
  if (mfh_boundary_sensitive) cat("<p><strong>Provisional precision comparison.</strong> The MFH covariance is on a boundary. Narrower intervals can reflect understated uncertainty rather than more reliable inference; their nominal 95% coverage is not established for this fit.</p>")
}
```


Change maps use one diverging scale centred on zero, with the same range on
every change map: blue indicates a decrease in `r change_noun` between the
two years, light grey no change, and red an increase. Domains without an estimate
are shown in a paler grey. The significance plots after the maps show the estimated
change in each domain with its pointwise 95% confidence interval: intervals that
exclude zero (statistically significant changes) are drawn in red, the others in
grey.

```{r change-figures, results='asis'}
change_files <- list.files(file.path(fig_dir, "change_figures"),
                           pattern = "\\.png$", full.names = FALSE)
# Headings from the method in the file name (change_map_<tag>.png,
# significance_<tag>.png): the change maps first, then the significance plots,
# each in method order.
change_mfh_label <- as.character(indicator_info$mfh_model[1] %||% mfh_selected_model %||% "MFH")
if (is.na(change_mfh_label) || !nzchar(change_mfh_label)) change_mfh_label <- "MFH"
change_method_tags <- c(fh = "UFH", fh_benchmarked = "UFH benchmarked",
                        mfh = change_mfh_label,
                        mfh_benchmarked = paste(change_mfh_label, "benchmarked"))
change_figure_heading <- function(f) {
  stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(f)
  kind <- if (startsWith(stem, "change_map_")) "map" else if (startsWith(stem, "significance_")) "sig" else "other"
  tag <- sub("^(change_map_|significance_)", "", stem)
  method <- if (tag %in% names(change_method_tags)) change_method_tags[[tag]] else gsub("_", " ", tag)
  switch(kind,
         map = sprintf("Change in %s%s: %s", change_noun, change_unit_suffix, method),
         sig = sprintf("Significance of changes in %s%s: %s", change_noun, change_unit_suffix, method),
         gsub("_", " ", stem))
}
change_figure_order <- function(files) {
  stem <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(files)
  tag <- sub("^(change_map_|significance_)", "", stem)
  method_rank <- match(tag, names(change_method_tags))
  method_rank[is.na(method_rank)] <- length(change_method_tags) + 1L
  kind_rank <- ifelse(startsWith(stem, "change_map_"), 1L,
                      ifelse(startsWith(stem, "significance_"), 2L, 3L))
  files[order(kind_rank, method_rank, files)]
}
if (length(change_files) > 0) {
  for (f in change_figure_order(change_files)) {
    label <- change_figure_heading(f)
    cat(sprintf("\n### %s\n\n", label))
    cat(sprintf("![%s](%s)\n\n", label,
                file.path(fig_dir, "change_figures", f)))
  }
} else {
  cat("*No change figures available.*\n")
}
```
